sections.title: PawSharp.Cache.Providers.RedisCacheOptions
sections.content:
PawSharp.Cache.Providers.RedisCacheOptions

Properties

ConnectionString

Redis connection string (e.g., "localhost:6379").

Password

Redis password (optional).

Database

Redis database number (default: 0).

ConnectTimeout

Connection timeout in milliseconds (default: 5000).

SyncTimeout

Sync timeout in milliseconds (default: 5000).

ConnectRetry

Number of connection retry attempts (default: 3).

DefaultExpiry

Default cache expiry time (default: 1 hour).
